name: Theodor Eberbach
original_name: テオドール・エーベルバッハ
source:
A surface pilot of the 666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken. Theodor fights purely for his own survival, rejecting everything else that might leave himself vulnerable, from his comrades in the 666th, and trusts no one around him. Though much younger than other members of the 666th, Theodor's skills are up there with the best, specializing in close combat he learned through knife self-defense.

After being captured by the Stasi in a failed attempt to defect to West Germany with them, he was tortured and his family was killed, giving him a deep hatred for the Stasi and anyone involved with them.
